headword: {発酵食品|はっこうしょくひん}

definitions.explanation: Food products that have been transformed through the action of microorganisms such as bacteria, yeast, or mold. Includes items like miso, soy sauce, natto, yogurt, and kimchi.

examples.japanese: ⟦{納豆|なっとう}→納豆：04930_nattou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{代表的|だいひょうてき}→代表的：05670_daihyouteki⟧な{発酵食品|はっこうしょくひん}だ。
examples.english: Natto is a typical fermented food.

examples.japanese: {発酵食品|はっこうしょくひん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{腸内環境|ちょうないかんきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Fermented foods are said to improve gut health.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧、⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧、{漬|つ}け{物|もの}⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発酵食品|はっこうしょくひん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{和食|わしょく}→和食：10436_washoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧だ。
examples.english: Japan has many fermented foods such as miso, soy sauce, and pickles, which are essential to Japanese cuisine.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan has a particularly rich tradition of fermented foods. Key examples include ⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧ (miso), ⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧ (soy sauce), ⟦{納豆|なっとう}→納豆：04930_nattou⟧ (natto), {漬|つ}け{物|もの} (pickles), ⟦{酢|す}→酢：01057_su⟧ (vinegar), and ⟦{甘酒|あまざけ}→甘酒：13519_amazake⟧ (sweet sake). Fermented foods have received increased attention for their health benefits.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {発酵食品|はっこうしょくひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{入|い}れる→取り入れる：04221_toriireru⟧ (to incorporate fermented foods)
- ⟦{伝統的|でんとうてき}→伝統的：04802_dentouteki⟧な{発酵食品|はっこうしょくひん} (traditional fermented foods)
- {発酵食品|はっこうしょくひん}⟦ブーム→ブーム：05511_buumu⟧ (fermented food boom)
